final: WITH artist_counts AS (SELECT ArtistId, COUNT(*) as album_count FROM Album GROUP BY ArtistId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(album_count) as total_count FROM artist_counts) SELECT ac.ArtistId, ac.album_count, CAST(ac.album_count AS REAL) / t.total_count as ratio FROM artist_counts ac CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
